thepale.configuration.title: The Pale
message.thepale.portal_refused: Something on the other side holds the portal shut.
message.thepale.north_only: Only the frozen island in the north answers this call.
message.thepale.anchor_kept: The respawn anchor kept your things
message.thepale.steam_failed: [The Pale] The steam couldn't start with this shader pack, so the old fog wall is drawn. The game log (logs/latest.log) says why.
message.thepale.finale.awaken: Something has woken in the Pale.
message.thepale.finale.horizon: A shape stands on the horizon, out in the Pale. It is coming closer.
message.thepale.finale.last_day: It is almost at the shore. One more day.
message.thepale.finale.arrived: It has reached the shore. At night it will come out of the sea.
message.thepale.finale.returns: It has come back to the shore.
message.thepale.finale.retreats: It goes back into the sea. It will return the next night.
message.thepale.finale.ashore: The Patchwork Abomination has come ashore.
commands.thepale.invasion.started: The invasion has started. Landing point: x %s, z %s.
commands.thepale.invasion.already: The invasion is already under way.
commands.thepale.invasion.defeated: The boss is already dead. Use the Heart of the Pale to cleanse the Pale.
commands.thepale.invasion.cleansed: The Pale has been cleansed. There is nothing left to summon.
commands.thepale.invasion.skipped: The boss now stands off the shore at x %s, z %s. It comes ashore at night when a player is near.
item.thepale.heart_of_the_pale.tooltip: Hold use in the Overworld to cleanse the Pale.
message.thepale.finale.heart_silent: The heart is silent here. It answers only in the Overworld.
commands.thepale.boss.spawned: The Patchwork Abomination is here. It is not part of the invasion: killing it changes nothing in the world.
advancements.thepale.finale.root.title: The Pale Stirs
advancements.thepale.finale.root.descrip: Something has woken in the Pale and is coming for your shore
advancements.thepale.finale.abomination_: Be there when The Patchwork Abomination dies
advancements.thepale.finale.cleansed.des: Cleanse the Pale with its own heart
message.thepale.finale.cleansed: The heart stops. The poison is gone, the fog is lifting, and beyond the sea there are new lands.
commands.thepale.cleanse.done: The Pale is cleansed. Open sea to %s blocks past the coasts, the seed's own lands from %s.
commands.thepale.cleanse.undone: The Pale is back (for testing). Biomes already turned into ocean and terrain already generated stay as they are.
